title: Robots and Cars of the Future
text:
In the future, many people will use robots at home. A robot can clean the floor and cook simple meals. Some robots can also talk to people and answer questions. Many families think this will make life easier.

Cars will also change a lot. Some cars will drive by themselves, without a driver. This can help people who cannot drive. Scientists say that these cars will be safer in the future.

questions.text: What can a home robot do?
options: Clean the floor and cook simple meals
People who live in the sea

questions.text: What is the writer's opinion about future technology?
options: It will probably make life easier
It is dangerous and should be stopped
It is too expensive for everyone to use
It has no effect on daily life

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about the future of driving?
options: Driving may become easier and safer
People will stop using cars completely
Cars will only be used in big cities

vocabulary.definition: machines that can do tasks, often automatically
less likely to cause harm or danger
a person who drives a car

paragraph_translations: En el futuro, muchas personas usarán robots en casa. Un robot puede limpiar el suelo y cocinar comidas sencillas. Algunos robots también pueden hablar con las personas y responder preguntas. Muchas familias piensan que esto hará la vida más fácil.

Los coches también cambiarán mucho. Algunos coches conducirán solos, sin conductor. Esto puede ayudar a las personas que no pueden conducir. Los científicos dicen que estos coches serán más seguros en el futuro.
